title: Pre-Refinance Payment Amount on the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
The payment a customer makes before the balloon of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract is refinanced is defined as follows.

1. **Payoff quote used.** The payoff quote dated on the payment date. Where more than one payoff quote is dated the payment date, the one issued first that day is used.
2. **Other amounts due before a refinance.** The payoff amount on that payoff quote less the balloon amount, never below zero.
3. **Refinance down payment.** The refinance down-payment percentage of the balloon amount, rounded to the cent. The refinance down-payment percentage is zero percentage points; every percentage-point amount that applies is added into it, the refinance down payment is figured on the balloon amount and rounded to the cent, every credit that applies is then taken off, and the refinance down payment never falls below zero.
4. **Pre-refinance payment.** The other amounts due before a refinance plus the refinance down payment, rounded to the cent.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

| Item | USD |
|---|---|
| Payoff amount on the quote dated the payment date | 21,486.20 |
| Balloon amount | 20,900.00 |
| Other amounts due before a refinance | 586.20 |
| Refinance down payment at zero percentage points | 0.00 |
| Pre-refinance payment | 586.20 |

Where a payoff amount were lower than the balloon amount, the other amounts due would be zero rather than negative.
